provenance.calibrationMathReference: scripts/generate_ace_reload_w157.py (W197/W198 rigid/quaternion/SLERP math only; no Ace tracks)

conversion.basisEvidence: Shared rig root-local +X forward / +Z up; +X maps to model -Z, +Y to -X, +Z to +Y. Presentation calibration reused from W197 Ace, applied to Duke root/rest/neutral matrices only. Source camera axis signs remain native QA.
conversion.restAttachment: v-GRIP attaches in source rest via R_rest * C^T / 32; P_t * inverse(P_rest) followed by inverse(P_0) gives C * R_0^T * R_t * C^T and 32 C R_0^T (p_t-p_0). Cumulative armature matrices used once, no outer .01 FBX transform.
conversion.bodyMotion: Source-derived Duke 80A8A53D, no Ace motion or per-frame authored body offsets.
conversion.retiming: Linear source seconds = 4.2 * normalized runtime progress; 61 samples / 60 intervals. Adjacent evaluated 30fps rotations use shortest-arc quaternion SLERP and linear translation.
conversion.endpointBlend: Final .95..1 only: smoothstep SLERP to identity and translation to zero. Frames 00 and 60 use exact accepted native/twohand displays.
